Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.verdict: Closed for QRE2-P34-01 as specified. Not every confirmation channel is safe: QRE-P35-01.
Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.R07_lateEvidence: The late first-day lift asks interruption.startedAt naming the holiday. A restatement with a start after the lift, by a declaration, a weekly review or a return report, is read: the I6 confirmation follows (ASK interruption.episodeId, never the 'as one period' lock), the trip's named confirmation applies the return, and no review asks through week 11. The plan equals the start time stated from the outset (R07a x3). Confirming the trip first asks the start time again; the restatement then applies the kept confirmation, by the same review for a weekly review or return report, by the next review for a declaration (R07b x3). A start before the lift keeps the return unchanged, with no later ask (R07d x3). Unconfirmed, the I6 question stays until the re-entry week ends and clears at week 7, as R7D-FREEZE-4 does for an unanswered late fact (R07c). The newest report decides in both orders (R07h). A timeless restatement leaves the start time unknown and asked, then a valid one answers (R07g, R07i). A replay changes nothing (R07j). Naming the holiday by its episodeId or by its report's event id is the same (R07k). With an earlier, separately applied return in the history, it resolves too (R07m). The lift and the restatement in one review work (R07q).
Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.R04_correction: The correction asks the holiday's start time. The restatement by each channel applies it, equal to the start stated from the outset; resent, the correction changes nothing; no later ask through week 11 (R04a x3).
Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.persistentAsks: Every remaining persistent ask is for a fact still unstated, and stating it clears it at any week probed. The holiday's start time with a kept correction or confirmation: R04_question_ignored, answered in week 8 (R04b); the trip's start time sent instead (R04c); a timeless restatement (R04d); a late lift then a correction (R04e); confirmation first, left to week 9, answered in week 9 (R07l). The I6 confirmation after a restatement clears with the re-entry week (R07c). The O-02 'as one period' ask for a report of the holiday that changes another fact persists while unanswered (R07o, through week 9). It is the pre-existing class: the same ask on 46934a0, and R7D-FREEZE-4 asks the confirmation persistently on the same input. A valid restatement ends it (R07f).
Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.escapes: Restating the trip's own start time does not answer the holiday's start time and stays asked (genuine). Re-correcting the trip back to its first dates applies it (R7D-FREEZE-4 asked). A timeless restatement of the holiday is consumed and the question stays (genuine).
Q1_QRE2-P34-01_everyPath.clinical: A 'restatement' whose reason text turns clinical ('Holiday, then the flu with a fever'; category unchanged) is no restatement: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED by every channel, inside the re-entry week (R07n) and after it (R07n2). The guard that makes this so is unpinned (QRE-P35-05).

Its only consumer is reentryBetween's RUN predicate: no reader hashes or spreads the at(k) objects, and historicalStateOf builds its own fields. evidence.rootCause: returnAfterPause re-reads a recorded return (recordedStop) only for a named report: 'else if(named){...}'. An own-return reading records the stop as the latest break's own days, so an unnamed same-dates report now satisfies the duplicate rule and is read as a single break. stateAtBreak then excludes the episode, and the holiday, never applied on its own, is not read at all.
evidence.practicalConsequence: An athlete who confirms the trip the way the coach's own question allows, or whose client re-sends the trip report, gets strength back at known loads with more sets. A 14-day holiday's strength return steps (MODERATE) are dropped. This is less conservative than R7D-FREEZE-4 on the same input, and it is the direction of SSCTR-P32-F01 (a later break never erases an earlier one's effect) through a duplicate.

findings.smallestFix: In returnAfterPause, read a same-dates unnamed report of the latest episode as a named one is read: replace 'else if(named){const last=...,r=last&&(last.id===i.episodeId||...)?recordedStop(...):null;...}' with a branch that also calls recordedStop(ctx,last.live.eventId,{start,end,days,startedAt}) when !named and (start??onDate(end,-(days-1)))===last.live.start&&end===last.live.end (interruptionEpisode's rule-2 test). recordedStop returns null for a return with no separate breaks, so single-break duplicates are unchanged. A scratch prototype (probes/out/qre2-p35-fixdup-prototype.scratch.diff; the worker owns the change) passes 95/95 directed and 1002/1002 suite, changes 0 of 172 corpus cases, and makes the unnamed re-send and the unnamed I6 confirmation equal the named ones (R07p, R07p2, R07r equal; QH17 P18 PASS; with the three harness fixes nothing fails on the 54 DEV and 22 probe cases). Directed tests RED on 8e78b8a should pin the QH17 shape (re-send after an OWN_RETURN return: the record and the doses equal the named re-read) and the QH18 shape (R07 answered, then confirmed by the same dates: equal to the named confirmation), with controls: a TRAINING_AFTER re-send keeps its row with unchanged doses, a continuity return is still asked, a single-break duplicate is unchanged.
